gaps.title: Multi-node session sharding
gaps.description: InferenceSession wraps a single adapter. Multi-node requires ShardedSession distributing inputs across N adapters and merging outputs.

tasks.task: Define ShardedSession extending InferenceSession with adapters list and shard_strategy field
tasks.test: Instantiate with 2 mock adapters; assert run() returns merged output from both

tasks.task: Implement round-robin and input-split strategies selectable via config
tasks.test: 4 inputs round-robin over 2 adapters; assert each adapter called exactly 2 times

tasks.task: Merge streaming generators from multiple shards in interleaved order
tasks.test: 2 mock adapters each yield 3 tokens; assert consumer receives 6 tokens in alternating order

gaps.title: Weight introspection UI
gaps.description: Left panel has an empty expansion placeholder. get_weight_keys() output is not rendered or editable.

tasks.task: Populate ui.expansion in left_panel.py with rows from session.adapter.get_weight_keys()
tasks.test: Mock adapter returns 3 keys; assert 3 rows rendered inside expansion

tasks.task: Add inline ui.input per row; on change dispatch apply_weight with parsed value
tasks.test: Simulate input change on 'layer.0.weight'; assert apply_weight called with correct args

gaps.title: JAX frozen param tree set_weight
gaps.description: JAX pytrees are immutable. set_weight must rebuild the frozen param dict rather than mutate in-place.

tasks.task: Use jax.tree_util to rebuild frozen param dict with updated leaf at dot-notation key path
tasks.test: 2-level nested param dict; set_weight('layer.bias', 0.5); assert new dict correct, original unchanged

tasks.task: Store updated params on adapter instance; confirm next run_inference uses them
tasks.test: set_weight then run_inference; assert apply_fn received updated params

gaps.title: Windows Unix socket TCP fallback
gaps.description: Unix socket transport references a Windows TCP fallback but the implementation is unwritten in both server.py and client.py.

tasks.task: In server.py _run_unix_socket: if sys.platform == 'win32', bind TCP socket on port+1 instead of AF_UNIX
tasks.test: Mock sys.platform='win32'; assert TCP socket created on expected port

tasks.task: Apply same detection and fallback in client.py unix_socket transport
tasks.test: Mock sys.platform='win32' on client; assert connects via TCP not AF_UNIX

gaps.title: HTTP chunked streaming — full RFC 7230 framing
gaps.description: stdlib http.server requires manual chunked Transfer-Encoding. Both server write path and client read path need explicit chunk framing.

tasks.task: Server /stream handler: write hex-length prefixed chunks per RFC 7230, terminate with 0-length chunk
tasks.test: Mock adapter yields 3 tokens; assert response body is valid chunked encoding with terminal chunk

tasks.task: Client stream(): parse chunked response by reading chunk sizes, assemble token strings
tasks.test: Feed correctly-formed chunked response; assert 3 tokens yielded in order

gaps.title: custom_cpp_adapter manifest schema and loader
gaps.description: CustomCppAdapter references manifest.json for ctypes signatures but schema and loader are unimplemented.

tasks.task: Define manifest.json schema: functions[]{name,argtypes,restype}, weight_keys[], input_format, output_format
tasks.test: Load sample manifest; assert all fields parse and argtypes resolve to ctypes types

tasks.task: In load_model: read manifest.json from binary directory, set ctypes argtypes/restype dynamically
tasks.test: Mock cdll + manifest with one function 'run'; assert argtypes set correctly on function handle

tasks.task: get_weight_keys(): call binary 'get_weight_names' symbol if present, else fall back to manifest weight_keys
tasks.test: Manifest weight_keys=['w1','w2'], no binary symbol; assert returns ['w1','w2']

gaps.title: Headless LLM any-provider integration
gaps.description: headless/server.py routes to InferenceSession which uses installed framework adapters. A provider-agnostic headless LLM path (Ollama, llama-server, any OpenAI-compatible local endpoint) is not wired.

tasks.task: Add config key 'headless_llm': {enabled, base_url, model, api_key_env} where api_key_env is optional env var name
tasks.test: Load config with headless_llm block; assert all keys parsed without error

tasks.task: Create core/llm_client.py: LLMClient(config) with infer(prompt) and stream(prompt) using urllib.request to POST to base_url/v1/chat/completions
tasks.test: Mock urllib response returning {choices:[{message:{content:'hi'}}]}; assert infer() returns 'hi'

tasks.task: stream() reads SSE lines ('data: {...}'), parses delta content, yields token strings, stops on 'data: [DONE]'
tasks.test: Feed 3 SSE lines + DONE sentinel to stream(); assert 3 tokens yielded and generator exhausts

tasks.task: Wire LLMClient into HeadlessOrchestrator: if config headless_llm.enabled, route infer/stream calls to LLMClient instead of session adapter
tasks.test: Orchestrator with headless_llm enabled + mock LLMClient; assert infer() calls LLMClient.infer not session.run

tasks.task: Expose headless_llm status in left panel status_dot alongside headless server dot
tasks.test: Config headless_llm.enabled=true; assert second status dot rendered with correct label
